## Not mechanically provable

Vouch checks only what artifacts can prove; where it cannot, it prints `NOT_CHECKED` rather than offering a button that fakes it.

- org.acceptance-ownership: a recorded owner identity proves a string was recorded, not that a person with authority and time validated intent
- org.intent-validation: whether the frozen pack tests *the right thing* is human judgment; red proves cases CAN fail, not that they should
- org.independence: identity comparison is a format heuristic (the 0.6 commit-author lesson), never proof of distinct people
- org.causal-red-history: an anchored chain proves ordering and anchor timing; no anchor mode proves *why* the red occurred
- org.protective-closure-truthfulness: a closure record proves a trigger and roster snapshot were recorded, not that the trigger was real or the response appropriate
